#Set Working Directory & Load Packages
```{r}
#set working directory
setwd("~/Desktop/blameassignment")

#load packages
library(psych)
library(effects)
library(corrplot)
library(corrgram)
library(stats)
library(plotrix)
library(plyr)
library(dplyr)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

```

#Load in Anonymized Data (this is the file available on OSF)
```{r}
#load in data frame
qualtrics <- read.csv("Blame Assignment Study 2 Anon.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

#turn all blanks to NA
qualtrics <- qualtrics %>% mutate_all(na_if,"")

#no headers
df <- qualtrics %>%
  filter(DistributionChannel == "anonymous") #226 entries

#frequency of each ID
df.duplicateIDs <- df %>% 
  group_by(anon_id) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(freq=n())

#df that has only unique IDs
df.unique <- df.duplicateIDs %>%
  filter(freq == 1)

#only retain rows in original data file that are in the "unique" df
df.2 <- 
  df %>% 
  filter(anon_id %in% c(df.unique$anon_id))

#filter out anyone who is not American
df.2 <- df.2 %>% 
  filter(citizenship == 1)

#filter out those who did not consent
df.2 <- df.2 %>% 
  rename(consent = Q11)

df.2 <- df.2 %>% 
  filter(consent==1)
```

#Make Condition Variable
```{r}
#condition
df.2$condition <- rep(NA,nrow(df.2))

df.2$condition[!is.na(df.2$unpackedisrael_1)] <- 1 #Unpacked Israel
df.2$condition[!is.na(df.2$unpackedpalestine_1)] <- 2 #Unpacked Palestine

table(df.2$condition, useNA="ifany")
table(df.2$condition)

```

#Data Cleaning
```{r}
#delete Qualtrics columns
df.2$Status <- NULL
df.2$Progress <- NULL
df.2$Duration..in.seconds. <- NULL
df.2$Finished <- NULL
df.2$RecordedDate <- NULL
df.2$RecipientLastName <- NULL
df.2$RecipientFirstName <- NULL
df.2$RecipientEmail <- NULL
df.2$ExternalReference <- NULL
df.2$DistributionChannel <- NULL
df.2$UserLanguage <- NULL

```

#Finalize Clean Data
```{r}
#create new data frame
df.3 <- df.2

#check consent
table(df.3$consent)

#check conditions
table(df.3$condition)

#turn all variables to numeric
df.4 <- data.frame(lapply(df.3, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x))))

```

#Data Demographics
```{r}
#gender
tablegender <- table(df.4$gender)
prop.table(tablegender)*100

#age
df.4 %>% summarize(mean_age=mean(age, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_age=sd(age, na.rm=TRUE),
            se_age=sd(age, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            lower_age=mean(age, na.rm=TRUE) - sd(age, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96,
            upper_age=mean(age, na.rm=TRUE) + sd(age, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96)

#race
tablerace <- table(df.4$race)
prop.table(tablerace)*100

```

#Create Identification & Position Variables
```{r}
#identification
df.identification <- df.4 %>%
  select(identification_1:identification_6)

df.4$identification <- rowMeans(df.identification, na.rm=TRUE, dims=1)

psych::alpha(df.identification)

#position - pro Israel
table(df.4$position1)

#position - pro Palestine
table(df.4$position2)

```

#Create Blame Variables
```{r}
#Condition 1: Unpacked Israel
#Condition 2: Unpacked Palestine

#unpacked Israel
df.4 <- df.4 %>% 
  mutate(c1_blamepalestine = unpackedisrael_1)

#unpacked Palestine
df.4 <- df.4 %>% 
  mutate(c2_blamepalestine = unpackedpalestine_2 +
           unpackedpalestine_3 +
           unpackedpalestine_4)

#blame Palestine variable
df.4$blamepalestine <- rep(NA,nrow(df.4))

df.4$blamepalestine <- pmax(df.4$c1_blamepalestine, df.4$c2_blamepalestine, na.rm=TRUE)

summary(df.4$blamepalestine)

#blame Israel variable
df.4$blameisrael <- rep(NA,nrow(df.4))

df.4$blameisrael <- 100-df.4$blamepalestine

summary(df.4$blameisrael)

```

#Analyses
```{r}
#Condition 1: Unpacked Israel
#Condition 2: Unpacked Palestine

#turn numeric variables into factors
df.4$condition <- as.factor(df.4$condition)
df.4$identification <- as.numeric(df.4$identification)
df.4$position1 <- as.numeric(df.4$position1)
df.4$position2 <- as.numeric(df.4$position2)

#set ANOVA defaults to SPSS defaults
options(contrasts = c("contr.helmert", "contr.poly"))
options("contrasts")

library(car)
library(sjstats)

#ANOVA - main analysis
anova1 <- lm(blamepalestine ~ condition, data = df.4)

Anova(anova1,type=3)

anova1effect <-Anova(anova1,type=3)
eta_sq(anova1effect, partial = T)

#summary statistics by condition
df.4 %>% dplyr::group_by(condition) %>% 
  summarize(mean_blamepalestine=mean(blamepalestine, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_blamepalestine=sd(blamepalestine, na.rm=TRUE),
            se_blamepalestine=sd(blamepalestine, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            lower_blamepalestine=mean(blamepalestine, na.rm=TRUE) - sd(blamepalestine, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96,
            upper_blamepalestine=mean(blamepalestine, na.rm=TRUE) + sd(blamepalestine, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96)

#ANOVA - with identification and position variables
anova2 <- lm(blamepalestine ~ condition + identification + position1 + position2, data = df.4)

Anova(anova2,type=3)

anova2effect <-Anova(anova1,type=3)
eta_sq(anova2effect, partial = T)

#correlations
cor.test(df.4$blameisrael, df.4$position2) #pro Palestinian position
cor.test(df.4$blameisrael, df.4$position1) #pro Israeli position
cor.test(df.4$blameisrael, df.4$identification) #connection & knowledge of conflict

```

#online supplementary materials - blame assigned to each subgroup
```{r}
#Condition 1: Unpacked Israel
#Condition 2: Unpacked Palestine

#Condition 1: Unpacked Israel
df.condition1 <- df.4 %>% filter(condition==1) %>% select(unpackedisrael_1, unpackedisrael_2, unpackedisrael_3, unpackedisrael_4)

df.condition1 <- df.condition1 %>% 
  rename(unpackedisrael_palestine = unpackedisrael_1) %>% 
  rename(unpackedisrael_israelrightwingbloc = unpackedisrael_2) %>% 
  rename(unpackedisrael_israelcenterbloc = unpackedisrael_3) %>% 
  rename(unpackedisrael_israelleftwingbloc = unpackedisrael_4)

df.condition1 <- df.condition1 %>% mutate(participantid = row_number())

df.condition1.long <- df.condition1 %>% pivot_longer(
  !participantid,
  names_to = "group",
  names_prefix = "unpackedisrael_",
  values_to = "blame",
  values_drop_na = FALSE)

condition1table <- df.condition1.long %>% group_by(group) %>% 
  summarize(mean_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_blame=sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE),
            se_blame=sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            lower_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE) - sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96,
            upper_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE) + sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96)


#Condition 2: Unpacked Palestine
df.condition2 <- df.4 %>% filter(condition==2) %>% select(unpackedpalestine_1, unpackedpalestine_2, unpackedpalestine_3, unpackedpalestine_4)

df.condition2 <- df.condition2 %>% 
  rename(unpackedpalestine_israel = unpackedpalestine_1) %>% 
  rename(unpackedpalestine_palestinehamasmovement = unpackedpalestine_2) %>% 
  rename(unpackedpalestine_palestinefatahmovement = unpackedpalestine_3) %>% 
  rename(unpackedpalestine_palestineislamicjihadmovement = unpackedpalestine_4)

df.condition2 <- df.condition2 %>% mutate(participantid = row_number())

df.condition2.long <- df.condition2 %>% pivot_longer(
  !participantid,
  names_to = "group",
  names_prefix = "unpackedpalestine_",
  values_to = "blame",
  values_drop_na = FALSE)

condition2table <- df.condition2.long %>% group_by(group) %>% 
  summarize(mean_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_blame=sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE),
            se_blame=sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            lower_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE) - sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96,
            upper_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE) + sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96)

```
